hero.filename: F4U-4 Corsair over Korea in September 1951.jpg
hero.caption: A U.S. Navy Vought F4U-4 Corsair (BuNo 82084) about to make a rocket attack on a North Korean railway bridge, September 1951. The aircraft was most probably assigned to Fighter Squadrons 791 (VF-791) "Fighting Falcons" and was assigned to Carrier Air Group 101 (CVG-101) aboard the aircraft carrier USS Boxer (CV-21) for a deployment to the Western Pacific and Korea from 2 March to 24 October 1951.
